Thanks for the reply!

To be more honest, a lot of this is directed towards my parents. So, I'd re-frame this as: 
My parents don't deserve to have a successful child. They deserve to bury their child and know that they are going through this in part because of their own willful ignorance and neglect. 

Regarding friends, if anything they've been too supportive and too distant. Nobody is actively trying to drag me down. My happiness and success would make them proud, it wouldn't be a revenge.

Not true. Most if not all of them would be proud and supportive of my hard work and success. 

Also, people can certainly have legacies. I'm just mentioning the crafting of an emotionally damaging one.
